english.note: Use 好笑 as the all-purpose choice for something amusing or humorous.
Use this when the amusing quality is specifically that it makes people laugh.
Use this for an amusing situation, joke, or performance, especially when simply saying that it is funny.

examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3

examples.english: This clip is really amusing—I laughed out loud watching it.
examples.traditional: 呢段片真係好笑，我睇到笑咗出聲。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 pin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3 ngo5 tai2 dou2 siu3 zo2 ceot1 seng1
ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3

english.note: Use this when something is funny or ridiculous, especially when the humour is unintended.
Use this when the ridiculous thing is funny or invites mockery, rather than merely being extreme.

examples.english: They look so serious that it actually seems comic.
examples.traditional: 佢個樣咁認真，反而好笑。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng6 gam3 jing6 zan1 faan2 ji4 hou2 siu3

examples.english: The way you are putting on that act is ridiculous.
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 baan6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3
